title: OpenAI publishes a system card for its DALL-E 3 image model
summary: OpenAI released a system card for DALL-E 3, a text-to-image model built to follow detailed natural-language prompts more closely than its predecessors.

title: Google presents an Assistant with Bard at its Made by Google event, with optional Gmail and Drive access
summary: Google showed an Assistant that gives personalised answers with optional access to Gmail, Drive and other services, launching first on Pixel devices in selected markets.

title: Yandex neural network learns to summarise Russian-language online videos, Rossiyskaya Gazeta reports
summary: From 6 October 2023 YandexGPT can write short summaries of Russian-language online videos of two minutes to four hours that contain speech.

title: Baidu launches Ernie 4.0 at Baidu World 2023 and says its overall level is comparable to GPT-4
summary: Baidu founder Robin Li announced the formal release of Wenxin (Ernie) 4.0 and said its overall level is not inferior to GPT-4; the comparison is Baidu's own claim.

title: US Commerce Department updates export controls on advanced AI chips and extends them to 43 more countries
summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security revised its October 2022 rules, changing the chip performance criteria and widening licence requirements, according to a Georgetown CSET explainer.

title: Xi Jinping announces China's Global AI Governance Initiative at the Belt and Road Forum, per the Chinese foreign ministry
summary: Xi said the initiative covers AI development, security and governance, and backs discussion under the UN framework of an international AI governance body.

title: Stanford researchers publish a Foundation Model Transparency Index rating ten AI developers
summary: Stanford's Center for Research on Foundation Models published an index that scores ten foundation-model developers on how much they disclose about their models.

title: Zhipu AI raises about USD 350 million from Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan, Ant Group, Xiaomi and HongShan, CNBC reports
summary: The Chinese language-model developer raised 2.5 billion yuan in a round reported on 20 October 2023.

title: Nvidia says US licence rules for some AI chip shipments to China took effect immediately, Habr reports
summary: Habr, citing Nikkei Asia, reports that restrictions first proposed with a 30-day lead from 17 October took effect immediately, covering chips made for the Chinese market under earlier rules.

title: UN Secretary-General announces a High-level Advisory Body on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Antonio Guterres announced the body in remarks on 26 October 2023 to advise on international governance of AI.

title: Google commits to invest up to USD 2 billion in Anthropic, CNBC reports
summary: Google agreed to put in USD 500 million upfront and a further USD 1.5 billion over time, about a month after Amazon pledged up to USD 4 billion.

title: G7 leaders adopt Hiroshima Process guiding principles and a voluntary code of conduct for advanced AI developers
summary: The G7 agreed eleven guiding principles for advanced AI systems and a voluntary code of conduct for AI developers.

title: President Biden signs an executive order on safe, secure and trustworthy AI
summary: The order sets federal requirements for AI development and requires developers of the most capable systems to share safety test results with the government before public release.

title: Alibaba Cloud releases Tongyi Qianwen 2.0 at its Yunqi Conference, Xinhua reports
summary: Alibaba Cloud CTO Zhou Jingren announced a model with hundreds of billions of parameters and said the 72-billion-parameter Qwen-72B would be open-sourced soon.

title: China's TC260 standards committee publishes draft basic security requirements for generative AI services for public comment, C114 reports
summary: The draft standard sets requirements on training data sources, content safety, model security and evaluation for providers of generative AI services in China.

title: Abu Dhabi's G42 and OpenAI announce a partnership to deploy OpenAI models in the UAE and the region, Al Ain News reports
summary: The partnership targets financial services, energy, healthcare and public services, with G42 building regional infrastructure for model inference on Microsoft Azure.

title: Sber launches an upgraded GigaChat model with doubled context and says it has reached 1 million unique users
summary: Sber said a new training method improved summarisation and question answering, and the model became available via VK and combined with its Kandinsky image model.

title: Latin American and Caribbean ministers sign the Santiago Declaration on ethical AI at a regional summit with UNESCO, El Mostrador reports
summary: Governments of the region agreed principles for ethical AI and a working group on regional AI governance, with Chile taking a coordinating role.

title: SoftBank starts operating a generative AI compute platform with over 2,000 Nvidia GPUs and begins building a 350bn-parameter Japanese LLM
summary: SoftBank said its subsidiary SB Intuitions began full-scale development of a Japanese-language LLM on a DGX SuperPOD cluster it described as one of Japan's largest.
